title: Unexpected medical-expense amount bands separate care foregoing from debt and household adaptation
source_unit: US adult SHED 2025 respondent with observed unexpected-expense amount

denominator.unit: respondents with complete care, coverage, and amount fields

observations.method: Weighted same-respondent cross-tab by E12_a amount band; care foregoing is any Yes among E1_a-E1_e; insured is any Yes among E4_a-E4_f; all outcomes use single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: Cross-sectional association with no bill identity, event order, amount precision, causal direction, or replicate-weight standard errors.
observations.subgroup: Respondents reporting $1 to $499 unexpected major medical expense.
observations.counterinterpretation: Small expenses may be concentrated among households with little liquid room or different care needs; amount alone does not identify burden.
